label: Тетрадь
description: Twelve-mission case drill for тетрадь (notebook, exercise book) — all six cases, singular and plural.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative singular. The dictionary form тетрадь is the subject of the sentence, so it keeps its bare -ь shape. Third-declension feminine nouns carry no ending in the nominative singular; the case marking only appears once the noun moves into the oblique forms.

Strategic focus: Genitive singular. The negation нет requires the genitive, and тетрадь shifts to тетради. The hallmark of the third declension is that genitive, dative, and prepositional singular all collapse into this one -и form, so тетради here matches the dative and prepositional exactly.

Strategic focus: Dative singular. The preposition к governs the dative, and the form becomes тетради. In the third declension the dative shares its -и ending with the genitive and prepositional singular; only the instrumental тетрадью stands apart with -ью.

Strategic focus: Accusative singular. The notebook is the direct object of открой, so it takes the accusative. Because тетрадь is an inanimate third-declension noun, its accusative is identical to the nominative — the bare -ь form тетрадь, with no special object ending.

Strategic focus: Instrumental singular. The preposition с governs the instrumental, and тетрадь takes its distinctive ending to become тетрадью. This -ью form is the single point where the third declension breaks pattern: while genitive, dative, and prepositional all share -и, the instrumental singular alone is -ью.

Strategic focus: Prepositional singular. The locational в governs the prepositional, so тетрадь becomes тетради. This -и ending completes the singular trio — genitive, dative, and prepositional are all written тетради — while only the instrumental тетрадью differs.

Strategic focus: Nominative plural. As the plural subject of the sentence, тетрадь moves to the nominative plural тетради. The third-declension plural marks the nominative with -и, the same vowel seen in the singular obliques but here signalling plurality.

Strategic focus: Genitive plural. The negation нет requires the genitive plural, and тетрадь takes the third-declension ending -ей to become тетрадей. This -ей is the regular genitive-plural marker for soft feminine nouns of this class, replacing the singular's -и.

Strategic focus: Dative plural. The preposition по governs the dative, and in the plural тетрадь takes the ending -ям, giving тетрадям. Unlike the singular, where the dative coincided with genitive and prepositional, the plural cases are all clearly distinct.

Strategic focus: Accusative plural. The phrase свои тетради is the direct object of проверяют, so it takes the accusative plural. Since тетрадь is inanimate, its accusative plural matches the nominative plural тетради rather than the genitive.

Strategic focus: Instrumental plural. The participle завален governs the instrumental of the cluttering means, and тетрадь takes the plural ending -ями to become тетрадями. The singular's special -ью yields in the plural to the ordinary -ями ending shared across the declensions.

missions.phrase: В этих тетрадях все мои записи.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. The locational в governs the prepositional, and тетрадь becomes тетрадях with the plural ending -ях. The singular merger of genitive, dative, and prepositional into -и does not carry into the plural, where each case keeps its own form.
